name: Requests
description: Let users request movies and TV shows, and manage every request from the dashboard.
overview: Adds a Requests button to the Jellyfin header so every user can search for movies and TV shows, using the metadata providers you already have, and request them: a whole movie or series, specific seasons or episodes, with a preferred quality and a note. Titles you already own are marked In library, and duplicates are flagged. Administrators manage all requests from the dashboard, with customizable statuses (name, color and icon), quality options and media types. No external services or API keys needed.

versions.changelog: Requests 1.1: request movies and TV shows (whole, by season or by episode) from a header button, with quality and notes; admin replies, customizable statuses (name, color, icon), quality descriptions, merged search results, In library and Already requested markers, theme-aware styling and optional animations.
